correctness.rationale: On the Segre quadric, the (3,3)-curve is smooth exactly for λ≠0, λ³≠1; adjunction gives genus four. Direct coefficient extraction from (QG)^4 over F5 reconstructs the 4x4 Cartier/Hasse–Witt matrix with outer invertible 2x2 block and middle B=[[λ²,1-λ³],[1,λ⁴+λ]], determinant −D, D=λ^6+2λ³−1. Polynomial GCD/Frobenius arithmetic confirms D irreducible and separable of degree six over F5 and avoids the singular boundary. Modulo D, B's first-column vector v=(λ²,1) obeys B*v^(5)=λ(λ³−1)v≠0, so the stable rank is 3 for genus4, 4 otherwise and the a-number is 1 or 0. The fixed-point-free 3-action has genus2 quotient V²=(r³+λr+1)²−4r³; independent quotient Hasse–Witt determinant D and semilinear stability give quotient ranks 1/2, forcing dimension2 Prym rank2 throughout via prime-to-5 isogeny. Separate exact symbolic extraction was performed, not only a saved verifier log.
